Subject: Re: Great meeting at FinTech Summit — discovery recap & MAP

Hi Sara — thanks for hopping on the call earlier today. Below is a short recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached).

Call recap (what I heard):
- Current: In-house model endpoints (NVIDIA A100 fleet), token-based costs spiking during peak batch scoring for fraud detection; inconsistent tail latency during batch windows.
- Pain: Need predictable per-request latency (sub-200ms P95 for scoring) and lower per-token cost at scale.
- Constraints: Strict data residency in US, SOC 2 compliance, and KMS for key management.
- Timeline/priority: Prototype by end of Q3; decision window early Q4.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive (60m) with Camila to map throughput requirements and test dataset (we can bring our benchmark harness).
2) Pricing ballpark and Dedicated vs Private deployment recommendation (we'll include cost estimates in the MAP).
3) Pilot scope: 4-week pilot, sample throughput 1k TPS burst, and SLO targets.

Attachments: FintechX-MAP-Redwood-20270503.pdf (MAP + benchmark plan).
Related links: hubspot deal (link below), benchmark report sample.

If that aligns, can you confirm who from your infra/security team should join the deep-dive and which pilot datasets we can use (anonymized)?

Thanks — happy to book the deep-dive at one of the slots below or work around your calendar:
- Thu 5/6 9–11am PT
- Fri 5/7 1–3pm PT
